title.ko: 비평문: 평가 어휘 · 구조 · 균형 잡힌 판단
title.en: writing critical reviews: evaluative language, structure and balanced judgement

explain.ko: 비평문(critical review)은 작품을 요약하는 데 그치지 않고 근거를 들어 평가하는 글입니다. 구조는 보통 작품 소개, 장점, 단점, 종합 평가와 추천으로 이루어집니다. 평가 어휘는 긍정(compelling, profound, outstanding)과 부정(clichéd, flawed, falls short)을 균형 있게 사용하고, 판단에는 구체적인 근거와 예를 곁들여야 합니다. 개인적 호불호보다 논거가 중요하며, 마지막에 대상 독자와 추천 여부를 밝힙니다.
explain.en: A critical review evaluates a work with evidence rather than merely summarising it. The structure is usually an introduction, strengths, weaknesses, and an overall verdict with a recommendation. Use positive (compelling, profound, outstanding) and negative (clichéd, flawed, falls short) vocabulary in balance, and back judgements with concrete examples. Argument matters more than personal taste, and the ending names the target reader and recommendation.

items.passage:
BOOK REVIEW
The Vanished Village
Set in a village disappearing due to redevelopment, this novel explores memory and identity. The prose is spare yet lyrical. The narrative sags somewhat in the middle. Nevertheless, the lingering effect of the final scene stays with you.

task.model: The novel handles the profound themes of memory and loss compellingly. However, the second half becomes rather clichéd and the ending is overly sentimental. On the whole, it is flawed but well worth reading. I highly recommend it to lovers of literature.

model_trans.en: The novel handles the profound themes of memory and loss compellingly. However, the second half becomes rather clichéd and the ending is overly sentimental. On the whole, it is flawed but well worth reading. I highly recommend it to lovers of literature.
